intro: This quest entrusts a traveler with a sample of altered snapjaw shell from the Barrens to deliver to Mura Runetotem in Silverpine Forest. It bridges the healing efforts of the tauren across continents, connecting the strange vitality of Kalimdor's plains to the blighted lands of the Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies. Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life. Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.

Take a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine. She is staying at the Sepulcher. With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can smell the dust of the Barrens on you, adventurer. You have traveled far.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, what is this? This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life. Amazing! I must study it further.
Thank you, friend. With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
